name: Kaigai Spam Mail Blocker
author: higherfield

sections.description:
Kaigai Spam Mail Blocker is a WordPress plugin that automatically detects and blocks spam or abusive contact form submissions, especially those originating from overseas.

The plugin analyzes submitted content and blocks messages that do not contain Japanese characters or consist primarily of alphanumeric characters, which are common patterns in spam messages.

Supported form plugins:

  • Contact Form 7
  • Elementor Pro Forms

No configuration is required. Simply install and activate the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/kaigai-spam-mail-blocker directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. The plugin will automatically start filtering spam submissions.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require any configuration?

No. The plugin works automatically after activation.

Will legitimate Japanese inquiries be blocked?

No. Submissions that contain normal Japanese text will not be blocked.
